description:
Work out the UK CBAM liability in pounds on goods imported from 1 January 2027: tonnes times the UK default embedded emissions for the commodity code times the CBAM rate for the sector, with the £50,000 threshold and, if an origin is sent, the EU CBAM cost of the same goods in 2027 for comparison.
Use when: the user asks about UK CBAM on aluminium, cement, fertiliser, hydrogen, or iron and steel goods. Instead: cbam_cost for imports into the EU.
Inputs: one line per commodity code: code (8 digits; a shorter code or words return candidates) and tonnes. value_gbp, the customs value of all CBAM goods over the last 12 months, tests the threshold. origin adds the EU comparison for that country.
Behaviour: summary states the result in one sentence. The UK sets one default per code for every origin. Until HMRC publishes the first quarterly rates, the rates are the illustrative ones GOV.UK published on 16 October 2026, shown in rate_basis and noted in assumed. Imports before the threshold trigger date owe nothing. Default values only; an estimate, not a return.
Constraints: no authentication, key or headers. At most 10 requests per 10 seconds per IP address; above that HTTP 429, so space out repeated calls.
